values.meaning: Spell Flux Bonus damage amplification on Overload
values.quote: ''Overload'' deals {{pp|type=[[File:Realm Warp.png|20px|border]] ''Realm Warp's'' Rank|key=%|25 to 100 for 4|0 to 3}} {{ccs|increased damage|magic}}
values.binNote: Wiki text describes this amplifier as keyed to Realm Warp's rank (0-3) with values 25/50/75/100%, but the bin's RyzeQWrapper.DamageAmp array is indexed by Overload's own rank (1-5) with values 40/50/60/70/80%. The two sources disagree on both the indexing variable and the numbers; recorded the bin's per-Q-rank values here since that is what the data file actually keys on for this spell slot.

mechanics.claim: Casting Ryze's other basic abilities (W/E) resets Overload's cooldown and grants a Rune stack, up to 2, letting Overload be recast much more often than its own cooldown suggests.
mechanics.quote: '''Ryze's''' other {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts reset ''Overload's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and charge a [[File:Overload 3.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' {{tip|stack}} for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 2 times.

mechanics.claim: Casting Overload consumes all currently held Rune stacks at once.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and consumes all [[File:Overload 4.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' stacks

mechanics.claim: If Ryze consumed the maximum 2 stacks, he also gains bonus movement speed, which does not itself change damage output.
mechanics.quote: If '''Ryze''' consumed 2 stacks, he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.

mechanics.claim: When enemies are affected by Spell Flux, Overload deals increased damage and spreads to nearby Fluxed enemies, applying spell damage to the primary target and area damage to secondary targets.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets affected by {{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}}.

mechanics.claim: Overload can be buffered up to 0.5 seconds before it comes off cooldown, effectively letting it be queued ahead of time.
mechanics.quote: ''Overload'' can be buffered {{fd|0.5}} seconds before it comes off cooldown.
